plans.goal: Ignite the braziers to create a wall of fire, rush in and grab the reliquary under cover of smoke
steps: Move down toward the braziers in the chapel
Light both braziers to create overlapping fire zones
Use the smoke and heat to advance unseen
Grab the reliquary from the altar

atoms.text: Rush down toward the left brazier
Light the brazier on the left
Grab the reliquary from the altar stone

atoms.strategy: Carry and escape through the flames
atoms.text: Carry the reliquary out through the burning chapel

plans.goal: Burn flammable props to create obstacles and traps, isolate enemies, then grab and run
steps: Ignite the table and crates to create a burning maze
Push Silas Crowe away from the reliquary
Grab the reliquary and dash for escape

atoms.text: Dash toward the center of the chapel
Light the crate on fire to block Marl's path
Escape with the reliquary through the burning chapel

plans.goal: Topple burning objects onto enemies, use fire walls to contain them, extract safely
steps: Shove a brazier at Silas to disrupt him
Burn the log to create a barrier on our escape route
Grab and carry the reliquary out

atoms.text: Advance toward Silas Crowe and the brazier
Shove the blazing brazier at Silas
Ignite the fallen log to create a wall of fire
Carry the reliquary back through the burning chapel
